# Back

Back is a self-help app for the first minute of a panic attack, acute anxiety, or sensory overwhelm. Six gentle tools start in one tap: Breathe, Distract, Ground, Move, Listen, and Read. There is no account. The tools work offline. Preferences and a support contact stay on the phone. The App Store privacy label is Data Not Collected.

Back is not therapy, a diagnosis, a medical device, or an emergency service. It does not promise to stop or treat panic. If someone may be in immediate danger, they should contact local emergency services.

Today every tool is free. A later paid plan called Back Plus is not available yet. Safety routes — Extra Support, emergency information, and Call my person — stay outside any future paywall.

Back is on the App Store for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811918141?mt=8&ct=llms
This project does not list a Google Play URL.

## Guides

- https://backapp.live/guides/what-to-do-when-panic-rises/ — What to do during a panic attack in the first minute.
- https://backapp.live/guides/when-breathing-feels-hard-during-panic/ — You do not have to force a breathing exercise.
- https://backapp.live/guides/grounding-when-thoughts-race/ — A gentle grounding version for racing thoughts.
- https://backapp.live/guides/asking-someone-you-trust-for-support/ — How to ask someone for support during a panic attack.
- https://backapp.live/guides/make-a-calm-time-support-plan/ — A panic attack plan made on a calm day.
- https://backapp.live/guides/panic-at-night-next-minute-plan/ — What to do in the next minute if panic wakes you at night.
- https://backapp.live/guides/panic-in-public-next-minute/ — Panic attack in public: quiet ways to get through it.
